consequence.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane v2.0.0 requires the operator to perform the 'Upgrade Crossplane core' step (step 2 of the documented upgrade approach); skipping it leaves the upgrade incomplete.
consequence.remediation: Follow the v2 upgrade guide's 'Upgrade approach' and perform step 2, 'Upgrade Crossplane core', as part of moving to Crossplane 2.0.0.

original.statement: The Crossplane v2.0.0 upgrade guide lists 'Upgrade Crossplane core' as step 2 of its upgrade approach, i.e. a required operator step when moving to Crossplane v2.

decision.reason: [ev-18e2ad34cf67] is only a table-of-contents link, and the section body [ev-c28095f20093] shows that step 2 is just the upgrade itself: add the Helm repository, upgrade to v2 and verify. It describes no separate change and no mandatory step beyond the upgrade. So 'migration-required' with 'skipping it leaves the upgrade incomplete' says nothing new and claims mandatory work that doesn't exist. The real v2 consequences are tied to the removed features covered in step 1 [ev-de978b4c1ed8] and to the MRAP and provider steps [ev-06a16cdbc869][ev-dd988a5ed5c3], which are separate changes, so no correct assertion follows for this item.
